li.label: Dysphorakh
li.description:
Sixty million years ago, Biotransference preserved this Necron's neural engrams in living metal — but it could not erase the ghost of what they were. The mind still maps to lungs that no longer draw breath, to a stomach long since dissolved, to skin stripped away in the process. Dysphorakh is the cascading phantom-biological condition that haunts them: drowning in lungs that are not there, starving in a body with no hunger to satisfy, buried alive inside their own frame.
In its most severe form, Dysphorakh becomes the Flaying Curse — the obsession that turns a Necron warrior into one of the Flayed Ones, draped in biological trophies in a futile attempt to feel alive again.

GeneDef.label: Dysphorakh
GeneDef.description: The phantom-biological condition unique to Necrons who never fully suppressed the organic memory of their pre-Biotransference body. Episodes of suffocation, hunger, and sensory horror cycle unpredictably. In severe cases, the Flaying Curse takes hold.
